name: Tideline
note: Tideline 3 preview. Derived in code from the published 2.1 tokens by applying the Tideline 3 foundation decisions (Geist, near-monochrome neutrals, 6/8/12/16 radii, 32/36/40 controls, 80/120/180/260ms motion). Token names are unchanged from 2.1 plus the additions marked 'Tideline 3'. Replace this file with the published Tideline 3 tokens.json and run `pnpm tideline:tokens`.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Level 0, the page. Tideline 3: white in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Level 1: cards, panels, table bodies. Sits on ground; separated by light plus shadow-surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tideline 3 muted fill: tracks, wells, secondary buttons, skeletons. Use text-2, not text-3, on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Level 2: menus, popovers, dialogs, sheets. Always paired with shadow-raised or shadow-floating.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, table rules, card edges in dark themes. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Group borders and the hover edge of a card.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The edge of a form control that must be seen to be used (3:1): inputs, checkboxes, switches.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Headlines, labels, values.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, meta, table secondary lines. On ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Placeholders and timestamps, on ground, surface and surface-subtle only (4.5:1).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (WCAG-exempt). Never for anything a person must read.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on a solid text-coloured fill (the inverse chip, the tooltip).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The primary action: ink fill in light, near-white in dark and live.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary (tonal) button fill, the selected nav row, the selected choice card wash.

tokens.name: on-action-soft

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on ground and surface. Always underlined in running text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour: 2px solid, 2px offset, at least 3:1 on every ground, surface and mesh base in its theme.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Duna's identity accent, non-text: the Sand Rating ring, the sun disc, milestone marks, the onboarding progress fill. Never a button.

tokens.name: sun-ink

tokens.name: sun-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind sun-ink (the rating chip, a celebration notice).

tokens.name: energy
tokens.usage: 2.1 energy accent (fill): level chips, QuickAction discs, the selected day in DayStrip, progress highlights, the TabBar centre action. Non-text mark; text on it is on-energy.

tokens.name: on-energy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an energy fill (9.2:1).

tokens.name: energy-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind energy-ink: a level chip at rest, an offer tag.

tokens.name: energy-ink
tokens.usage: Energy as text (levels, 'Member price'). On ground, surface and energy-wash.

tokens.name: attention

tokens.name: attention-wash

tokens.name: on-attention

tokens.name: info

tokens.name: scrim

tokens.name: club-core

tokens.name: club-ink
tokens.usage: Club slot, text: the club name in an identity chip, on club-tint (7:1+).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo at Expanded width (font-stretch 118 to 125%) and heavy weight: the broadcast voice. Sentence case, nothing above it.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Your club, on the beach and online.
styles.usage: One per page: the public hero, the onboarding welcome. clamp(44px, 6vw, 72px); font-stretch 125%.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers and the mobile hero title. clamp(34px, 4.4vw, 48px); font-stretch 125%.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Desktop product: PageHeader titles in HQ and Player web, dialog titles. font-stretch 106% (2.1: was 32px at 118%).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Tideline 3: section heading.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and sheet titles, section headings inside a page. font-stretch 100% (2.1: was 22px at 112%).

groups.name: Phone
groups.note: 2.1 phone ramp (390pt design width): Archivo at 100% width so names never wrap; Instrument Sans for the rest.

styles.name: phone-title
styles.usage: Screen titles and greetings on phones. font-stretch 100%. Never wider.

styles.name: phone-heading
styles.usage: Section headings on phones (Your clubs, Open matches).

styles.name: phone-nav
styles.usage: Tideline 3: navigation bar title on a phone.

styles.name: phone-body
styles.usage: The phone body floor (15).

styles.name: phone-meta
styles.usage: The metadata floor (13), always text-2 or darker.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: TabBar labels and chip micro text. 12 semibold is the absolute floor.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Instrument Sans for every word a person reads or taps. Never below 12px; inputs 16px.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Book a court, join an open match or add a result.
styles.usage: Leads under display and headline; marketing paragraphs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Players see this when they book.
styles.usage: Default reading text and all input values (iOS never zooms).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, nav items, field labels, list-row titles.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: HQ table cells, card details, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, chip labels, timestamps. Minimum public supporting text.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: The floor, semibold only: tab-bar labels, day names in DayStrip. Never below, never regular weight.

groups.name: Numerals
groups.note: Archivo with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for every number that updates or aligns: scores, ratings, money, counts.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Courtside live score (live zone). font-stretch 100%, tabular. 64px on phones in portrait.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Sand Rating hero, match result set scores, revenue totals. font-stretch 112%, tabular.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Metric cards, price on a plan card, booking total. Tabular.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers inside tables, chips and rows. Tabular, Archivo at 100% width.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Tideline 3: codes, ids and keyboard keys in Geist Mono.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Breathing room only: never stretch cards or copy beyond their caps.

duration.note: Calm, never bouncing. Every token has a reduced-motion value in the README (most become 0ms opacity-only).

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback (scale 0.98). Reduced motion: no scale, colour only.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover fill, colour and ring changes. Reduced motion: unchanged (no movement).

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Switch, segmented thumb, tab underline, checkbox draw. Reduced motion: 0ms, state jumps.

tokens.name: duration-settle
tokens.usage: Popovers, notices, toasts entering. Reduced motion: 120ms fade, no translate.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs rising. Reduced motion: 160ms fade, no translate.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Section reveal (once, on entering the viewport): rise 12px plus fade. Reduced motion: none, at rest.

tokens.name: duration-loader-sunspot
tokens.usage: 2.1 Sunspot: one orbit of the sun dot (inline in buttons, search). Reduced motion: static sun, label says Loading.

tokens.name: duration-loader-sunrise
tokens.usage: 2.1 Sunrise: the sun rising over the tideline and setting again (section, full page, pull to refresh). Reduced motion: risen sun, still.

tokens.name: duration-loader-ripple
tokens.usage: 2.1 Sand ripple: three ripples drifting (inline section placeholder). Reduced motion: still ripples at 70%.

tokens.name: duration-loader-shimmer
tokens.usage: 2.1 Tide shimmer: skeleton sweep. Reduced motion: flat surface-sunken blocks.

tokens.name: duration-mesh
tokens.usage: The only ambient loop: a mesh's stops drifting on a hero or celebration. Reduced motion, data saving and hidden tabs: paused.

tokens.name: duration-loading-delay
tokens.usage: Tideline 3: a loader shows nothing for work that finishes sooner than this.

tokens.name: duration-loading-min
tokens.usage: Tideline 3: once a loader shows, it stays at least this long, so it never flickers.

tokens.name: duration-search-debounce
tokens.usage: Tideline 3: quiet time before a typed search is sent.

tokens.name: ease-tide
tokens.usage: Anything that moves: sheets, reveals, the segmented thumb, the score tick.

tokens.name: ease-ui
tokens.usage: Colour, fill and ring changes.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Leaving: dismissed sheets, toasts going away.

blur.note: Glass only, and only over a mesh or a washed photo.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Glass panes and the mobile dock (with saturate 1.3 in light, 1.1 in dark).

tokens.name: blur-mesh
tokens.usage: The softness of mesh stops when drawn as blobs (native).

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table heads, sticky booking rail.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sidebar, top bar, mobile dock.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet scrim.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and the offline banner.
